Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

I have found you wanting.

Spend 1 Investiture and test Black vs. Cognitive against a creature in Attunement Range. On success, until the start of your next turn, that creature's damage die size decreases by one step (minimum d4).

CensureTest00000.description: Sovereignty (Verdannis). Black vs Cognitive against a targeted enemy in Black Attunement Range (both vetoed BEFORE cost — the range gate is the card's text, newly enforced this pass). 07-25 pass 2bT: replaced the preUseItem takeover (iron rule 2b); YOU roll the Black test on the card now.

CensureHit000000.description: Sovereignty (Verdannis). Success: Diminished — damage die −1 step (all damage) until the start of your next turn.

Cost: 2 Investiture

By my decree, you are diminished.

Spend 2 Investiture and test Black vs. Cognitive against a creature in Attunement Range. On success, for the scene, that creature's damage die size decreases by one step (minimum d4). On failure, the decrease lasts until the start of your next turn. Once per creature per scene.

description.value:
Activation: 2

Cost: 2 Investiture

You have been judged. You have been found lesser.

Spend 2 Investiture and test Black vs. Spiritual against a creature in Attunement Range. On success, for the scene, that creature's damage die size for attacks decreases by two steps (minimum d4), and each time it fails an attack test, each ally in Attunement Range gains temporary HP equal to your Tier. On failure, decrease its damage die size by one step until the start of your next turn.

EdictHit00000000.description: Sovereignty (Verdannis). Success: −2 steps on ATTACK damage for the scene, and the failed-attack rider travels IN THE ENTRY (failThpFormula @tier / White range) — each attack test the creature fails grants your allies in range Temp HP = your Tier (the GM roll watch reads it back as data).

handler.note: each attack test it fails grants your allies in White range Temp HP = your Tier (auto).

Weakness is its own invitation.

When a creature affected by your Censure fails a test, you recover 1 Investiture. When that creature fails an attack test, any ally in Attunement Range who is that attack's target may make a Reactive Strike against it.

ExposeReact00000.description: Sovereignty (Verdannis). Always Active (no use event) — the GM roll watch sweeps this rule: a creature Diminished by YOUR censure/decree entries (Ben R3) fails a test → recover 1 Investiture (auto on readable failed attacks, owner-click card otherwise), and a targeted ally in White range is offered the Reactive Strike (player-executed). 07-25 pass 2bT: replaced the edhaOwnsTalent name check inside the roll watch (iron rule 2b) — the Calculated Patience shape.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 2 Investiture

One rises. One falls. That is the natural order.

Spend 2 Investiture and choose one willing ally and one enemy in Attunement Range. Until the start of your next turn, the ally's damage die size increases by one step (maximum d12) and the enemy's damage die size decreases by one step (minimum d4). If the ally hits the enemy this round, both effects extend by one additional round.

SovBalancePair00.description: Sovereignty (Verdannis). Linked pair: targeted willing ally +1 / targeted enemy −1 until the start of your next turn; onPairHit 'extend-once' is stamped into both entries — the GM roll watch extends both one round when the ally hits the paired enemy (cast round only, once). 07-25 pass 2bT: re-litigated from the ENGINE-OWNED exit to a full conversion — the coupling is entry DATA now, not a name-keyed branch.

handler.note: if the ally hits the enemy this round, both effects extend one additional round (auto-detected).

Capstone pair: ally +2 / enemy −2 for the scene, once per scene (vetoed pre-cost); onPairHit 'no-reactions' — each detected ally→enemy hit posts the reaction-denial card (the denial itself stays GM-enforced, declared manual: no hook can forbid another creature's action). 07-25 pass 2bT: re-litigated from the ENGINE-OWNED exit to a full conversion.
